name: Terminal Experience
description: Lets a person work with the AI from a plain terminal: converse with the hub line by line, or watch any harness live, with each step and helper in place, Escape to stop and keep the session, resume, a correction shown as sent and taken up, a risky step waiting for y or n, the structure of the work as lines, and the closing report. As a command (`ahohs`, `ahohs work`) it runs a goal on a real harness, or asks for one, and a follow-up continues the session; it shows the structure tree only on request, the ceilings against spend and time, the hub's own stop decision in one line, and who the AI acts for.
purpose: Let a person converse with the hub and watch, stop, resume and steer the AI from a plain terminal, with any harness.
approach: Draw the session's events and read keys and lines back as the session's controls, through one shared driver: in place with the standard library (live_session), as a full-screen Textual screen with a scrolling transcript, input history, command completion and a rendered answer (textual_session), or as plain lines (line_repl). Built on the strongest open-source parts, and the decision for every reviewed terminal (arm, part or not adopted with its reason) is recorded in the registry.
out_of_scope: The contract of events and controls and the harness adapters (AI Session Experience), plain data for a separate frontend (Frontend Interface), choosing which structure to show and what is inside it (Structure In View), how a run is answered (the front door), and a consumer's own commands, data and words, which stay in its binding (`commands`, `segments`, `panels`, `front_door`, `represent`, `records`).
milestones: 1. The requirements of docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md that a scripted session can show are met on the hub's loop and on a stream session (authoritative metric metric-terminal-session).
knowledge: Placement against siblings: the other two children draw the same events for something that is not a terminal (Frontend Interface) or decide what structure is worth showing (Structure In View); the terminal is the reference surface, so it keeps the existing code and the existing scripted metric, and its arms compete on keys, redraw and the line REPL baseline. Compared with Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, Aider and others on 2026-11-10 (registry area terminal_agent_experience). Adoption decisions per finding: registry area terminal_agent_experience, columns adoption, adopted_as and adoption_reason (licences read at the source on 2026-11-10); the Textual arm is built on the Textual and Rich libraries (MIT), with the consumer's own Textual screen as its starting point. Selection: live_session and textual_session tie on every scripted and real-terminal case, so the incumbent stays (esoi select --promote finds no clear winner). Selection, 2026-11-12: the selected terminal is opencode_client_session because the cascade of metric-terminal-presentation chooses it, not because of anyone's preference: on the cases every arm can be driven through (the stage common) it scores highest, with the capability probes of the screen (a command palette, many commands, sessions, tabs, going into helpers, a marker per kind of update) run on every arm including the stock clients, and the owner's trial verdicts enter as the human trial stage (the component terminal_trial), which the stage requires: an arm with a recorded limit is not selectable until a later verdict replaces it. `esoi cascade terminal-session` shows the numbers. A consumer may keep its own line terminal as a fallback through its own switch.
measures_of_success: Share of scripted sessions right: every typed line reaches the front door, stop then resume loses nothing, a steer is taken up in the next call and shown, helpers show with their parent, a risky step waits, the same script passes on two harnesses.
inputs: A harness (start and control), a goal, a text stream, optional key source; or lines and a front door for converse.
outputs: The text written, and a SessionReport (last Finished, every run, all events, the controls and whether each was taken); for the structure, plain lines.
effects: Runs the harness in a thread, reads keys (Escape, Ctrl-C, lines), writes to the stream it is given, and redraws in place only on a terminal.
usage_notes: Contract: hubofhubs/the_consciousness/ai_session_experience/session_events.py. The command: hubofhubs/the_consciousness/ai_session_experience/terminal_experience/work.py (`ahohs work`, bare `ahohs`). Demo with no model: python -m hubofhubs.the_consciousness.ai_session_experience.terminal_experience.live --demo loop. Requirements and research: docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md.
change_driver: how people want to talk to the hub from a terminal
